scope: Existing records and CPU graph/numerical checks. No new learned-policy or simulator execution.

cpu_tests.scope: Synthetic sampler/adapter/protocol regressions, not trained control accuracy

selected_heads.interpretation: Draw-count ratio, not distinct coverage or an epoch: sampling is episode-uniform with replacement.
Draw-count ratio, not distinct coverage or an epoch: sampling is episode-uniform with replacement.

consistency_graph.scope: Exact loss graph, synthetic frozen dynamics; no learned checkpoint or physical trial.
consistency_graph.forward_context_in_consistency: One encoded state per independent transition, rather than the three-state history used by inference after warmup.
consistency_graph.conclusion: This loss regularizes the inverse decoder on recorded paths. It does not train the flow generator with dynamics feedback.

illustrative_case.interpretation: These are complete closed-loop policy outcomes. They do not isolate the causal effect of the first action because later replanning differs.

visual_review.scope: Two fixed cases, five saved controller trajectories each, six archived frames and goal per row. Not a representative or complete visual review.

limitations: No dataset/checkpoint replay: trained policy weights and source HDF5 data were not in the exported repository evidence.
Across-trajectory cost/error medians are descriptive, not matched counterfactual accuracy measurements.
Absence of a flow consistency gradient is also present in the inspected upstream LeFlow training code; not an isolated explanation of our reproduction gap.
inference: Shared base-policy/decoder quality and score-versus-execution mismatch are higher-priority diagnostics than another sampler. No single causal implementation bug established.
